qualification_limits: Runtime UNKNOWN_NO_RECEIPTS_REVIEWED_NO_EXECUTION for every root; source categories do not assert runtime pass/fail.

All NATS fixtures here directly start upstream server.NewServer and use nats.Connect(ClientURL()) over loopback TCP, not natscell in-process connections. Single server/replica fixture does not establish regional cluster resilience.

Foundation intends real signed OCI SDK HTTPS requests via custom DialTLSContext to literal loopback; SDK defaultHTTPDispatcher uses OciHTTPTransportWrapper and DefaultTransport, which normally replaces fixture Proxy and DialContext with ProxyFromEnvironment and net.Dialer unless OCI_GOSDK_USING_EXPECT_HEADER=false. Custom DialTLSContext remains cloned, but inherited proxies can use another route. No runtime environment/proxy configuration or network containment is proved. Handler checks Authorization prefix Signature only, not RSA signature independently. API records are synthetic; no live OCI or instance-principal authorization guarantee.

Function material/retirement uses real OCI SDK HTTP against synthetic loopback handlers and real local JetStream. Recipient/task-absence callbacks do not exercise scheduler/host admission. Lost reply is handler state transition followed by HTTP500, not a real network transport loss.
Generation Vault Read is an in-memory callback; filesystem/JetStream credit does not transfer to OCI Vault delivery or privileged installer behavior.

Host runner is memoryRunner (or wrapper), so no native process supervision, cgroup, TerraBase or operating-system clock discipline is established. Injected time/context/channel hooks only control source scenario.
GitHub fixture executes local shell/cat with argv readback; no actual gh installation, credential, external repository or GitHub API behavior is established.
All safety obligations retained; retirement_authorized false; no source/runtime/ledger/deletion/count promotion. Prior frozen packets remain unchanged.
